paragraphs: Miller Mendel, Inc. creates, sells and supports software for city, county, state and federal public safety agencies. Its first and flagship product, eSOPH, is a cloud-based system for public agencies that must run in-depth pre-employment background investigations on their applicants. Since 2011 its customers have been city police departments, county sheriff's offices, state police agencies, district attorney's offices and other criminal justice entities.

The company says eSOPH has been credited with cutting the time to process a background investigation by more than 50%, so applicants can be hired more quickly. Partnerships with Experian and Fama Technologies add one-click retrieval of credit reports and of social media and online activity reports. A captain at the Riverside County Sheriff's Department in California, which conducts over 2,500 applicant investigations a year, estimates a 50% time saving per investigation.

Miller Mendel describes itself as a minority owned, small business. It reports serving over 16,000 agency users. More than 90% of new clients, it says, come by referral from existing eSOPH users. In April 2026 NEOGOV, a workforce management platform built for the public sector, announced it had acquired Miller Mendel and was bringing eSOPH into its public safety software portfolio. The release said eSOPH was used by more than 300 customers, including some of the largest law enforcement agencies in the country.

quote.text: Since 2011, Miller Mendel has provided the most advanced and dependable pre-employment background investigation software system to public safety agencies across the nation.
